entryAndAssessment.ResearchSeminarsIandII: 10 EC each; historical-source research, written papers and presentations. First paper 3000–3500 words; second 4000–5000. Both must pass before BA2 research seminars.
entryAndAssessment.BSA: 45 EC and at least one first-year research seminar passed; a full passed first year satisfies the illustrated second-year entry gates.
entryAndAssessment.PapyrologicalSources: 5 EC; Ancient History and BSA required. No ancient Greek prerequisite in the inspected module entry text. Assignments 60%, paper 40%, presentation pass; paper at least 5.5.
entryAndAssessment.DigitalCartography: 5 EC; BA History admission; weekly assignments and examination 50% each.
entryAndAssessment.AfricaSeminar: 10 EC, autumn; 5000–6000 word paper 50%, participation 10%, presentation 10%, literature discussion 10%, group presentation 20%. Current OSO resolves legacy first-year seminar names in module entry.
entryAndAssessment.PhilipIISeminar: 10 EC, spring; 5500–6500 word paper 50% and must pass, group work 20%, presentation 20%, participation 10%. Spain-focused history; not a Dutch national survey.
entryAndAssessment.ChoicePolicy: One lecture, research seminar and sources/methods option in each semester; restricted menu illustration, no retired-route rationale or free-elective assumption. Noncredit orientation/study-plan meetings not counted.
